⚠️ Trial Divergence & How MANDOROS Adapted (Transparency Matrix & Narrative Summary)

🧬 Homogeneous Single-Drug Cohort

Methodological Adaptation Strategy: All pooled trials share the active ingredient (Dapagliflozin). MANDOROS applied standard inverse-variance random-effects meta-analysis (DerSimonian-Laird & REML). Outcomes were harmonized directly using exact parameter definitions. Specifically, because DAPA_HF_Trial measured 'device - cardiac resynchronization therapy' over 18.2 months (Dapagliflozin 10mg (10.0 mg - experimental); Placebo (nan nan - placebo)) and DECLARE_TIMI_Cohort measured 'worsening renal function composite' over 18.2 months (Dapagliflozin 10mg (10.0 mg - experimental); Placebo (nan nan - placebo)), MANDOROS automatically applied Tier 2 Scale-Free Standardized Mean Difference (Hedges' g SMD) and clinical domain bridging (Other Clinical & Laboratory Endpoints) to synthesize their therapeutic impact on a unified, dimensionless scale while computing monthly rate-of-change trajectories to reconcile differing follow-up horizons.

🧬 In-Silico Discovery & Synthesized Virtual Clinical Trial

MANDOROS Novel Inferred Evidence

Synthesizes the collective variance of all loaded trials to reconstruct missing unmeasured trial data, detect cross-trial emergent hypotheses, and formulate a complete de-novo optimal virtual trial blueprint.

💡 Novel Emergent Scientific Hypotheses & Sweet-Spot Inflections

🎯 Evaluated Dose Spectrum & Observed Efficacy Evidence Bounded (Direct Trial Observations)
Tested Dose Spectrum: 10 to 10 mg/day @ 18 Weeks
The trial evaluated 10 mg and 10 mg daily regimens against placebo over 18 weeks/days. While both active doses demonstrated significant improvements in glycemic parameters compared to placebo, the trial was not designed to test statistical superiority between the two active doses, and did not designate either dose as statistically 'optimal' based on empirical study evidence.
🧬 Exploratory Responder Phenotype Hypothesis Exploratory Hypothesis (Aggregate Trial Limitations)
Responder Hypothesis: Elevated Baseline adverse event - amputation (Exploratory / Unvalidated)
Exploratory Hypothesis: Directly reported patient phenotypes require individual patient-level data (IPD) or pre-specified trial stratification. In aggregate trial results, higher baseline adverse event - amputation correlates with larger absolute numerical reductions, which reflects statistical regression to the mean and baseline severity rather than a verified distinct genetic or clinical phenotype.
🕸️ Cross-Biomarker Metabolic Relationship Evaluation Exploratory Hypothesis (Ecological Fallacy Protection)
Biomarker Linkage: adverse event - amputation ⟷ adverse event - diabetic ketoacidosis (Exploratory / Unvalidated)
Exploratory Hypothesis: Cross-biomarker correlation between adverse event - amputation and adverse event - diabetic ketoacidosis cannot be mathematically established from marginal aggregate trial summaries without patient-level covariance matrices. Reporting a fixed correlation coefficient across group means would commit the ecological fallacy.
